text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAH--!!)

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"The Kyodo News Hai! That was so 
thrilling! What an incredible race!"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Will your next stop be the Satsuki Sho on 
the Classic Triple Crown route?! Please 
share your enthusiasm with us!

Displaying talent to the fullest at the 
Kyodo News Hai. Excited reporters click 
their camera shutters one after another.

However, the truth about our upcoming 
rotation is—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Umm... wait a second. Did I say I was 
aiming for the Triple Crown route?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There are candidates like the Satsuki Sho 
or the Oka Sho, but I haven't decided just 
yet.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Y-You haven't decided...? Why? What on 
earth is her Trainer doing—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's not your fault, Trainer. It's just 
that I haven't made up my mind yet.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
We enter races that both of us agree on. 
Because that's our rule.

A stir rippled through the crowd. Just as 
I stood up to step in and help—
Cee Beeee!!

The one who came barreling in like a storm 
was Katsuragi Ace.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you're hesitating, then come to the 
Satsuki Sho! And face me there!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
"I've been looking forward to this! 
Surpassing you and becoming the "Ace" of 
this generation!"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, really?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Could that be... Katsuragi Ace?

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Yes. If I recall, she was an Umamusume 
who's been on a winning streak lately...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Why her against Mr. C.B.? I mean... isn't 
the gap in their level a bit too wide...?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...Level, huh.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
I'll overturn all of that! Because I... I 
have to beat you...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —Face me in the Classic circuit, C.B.!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ............ ...Heh. Haha, ahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Man, Ace, you're unbelievable! Barging in 
here like that and saying all those 
things...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: Wh... What's your problem!?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Even so, "fight me", huh. ...I 
like it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, Trainer. Can I take it on? The 
best-of-three match against Ace!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Y-You mean—?!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
The Satsuki Sho is next. ...Time to defeat 
Katsuragi Ace, I suppose.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: ...! Heheh! Alright!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Breaking news, breaking news... and here! 
Found it! Let's see, what is it...—

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Oh! Sticking to the Classic Triple Crown 
route, after all! Right on, this year's 
gotta be CB's year!

text_block_list.name: Brown-haired Young Man
text_block_list.text:
Man, I'm so excited! I wonder if she'll 
win the Satsuki Sho...!

Mr. C.B. will enter the Satsuki Sho. Her 
virtual declaration to pursue the Classic 
Triple Crown—

It seemed to light a small flame in the 
hearts of those longing for a new myth.
